person.name: Dominic Reeves
person.headline: Product-owning systems designer/builder for AI and complex financial products
person.title: Product Design Lead / Design Engineer

profile.summary_short: I turn technically dense AI and financial products into systems teams can ship, users can trust, and companies can scale.
profile.summary: Product design lead and design engineer working across product strategy, UX architecture, design systems, and implementation for AI-native and complex financial products. Strong in 0→1 and scaling environments where the product is technically dense, the roadmap is ambiguous, and the team needs someone who can define the system, align the work, and ship to production. Experience spans enterprise analytics, DeFi, NFT infrastructure, and agent-native workflows. Led and scaled a £25M+ analytics product, supported $200M+ in deposits, and managed teams of 40+ designers and developers.

leverage: Turn ambiguity into a product model, working UX, and shippable roadmap
Reduce complex workflows into systems users can understand and teams can maintain
Build the design system and implementation layer together, not as separate afterthoughts
Work directly with engineers and often inside the stack
Stay close to production, telemetry, and actual system behavior
